name: White supremacy
summary: White supremacy is the belief that white people are inherently superior to other races and should hold power, privilege and often separate territory. Its adherents draw on 19th and early 20th century race science, defend or seek segregation, exclusion of non-white immigrants and denial of equal political rights, and frequently adopt antisemitic conspiracy theories. Strands range from legal segregationists and slaveholder ideology to Nazi-style racial states, white nationalist ethnostate projects and violent militias.
scope: The doctrine of white racial superiority as stated in Lothrop Stoddard's The Rising Tide of Color Against White World-Supremacy (which names white supremacy) and Madison Grant's The Passing of the Great Race, a founding Nordicist text that Wikipedia's account of white supremacy names, with white nationalism as the separatist strand. It does not cover racism generally, non-white supremacist movements or the economic and religious positions of particular movements, which vary.
